system.name: Joint-Teaching
system.one_liner: Systematic task-specific knowledge-distillation study for NLG, covering architecture, pruning, objective and pseudo-target choices, and proposing Joint-Teaching.

content.variant_note: eight titled stages joined by heavy arrows, each with a column of option boxes of which the chosen one has a bold border; an extreme-setup column at the right
content.argues: KD design choices are examined one stage at a time (architecture, pruning, objective, pseudo-targets, joint teaching), the best kept by dev performance; a no-label GPT-4 setup is added.
content.subject: Eight KD study stages as columns of option boxes with the chosen one outlined, plus an extreme-setup column.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a staged study as a row of titled stages with a menu of option boxes under each and mark the chosen option by a heavy outline, so the chosen path reads left to right; give each stage its own hue and use grey for the plain baseline.
lessons.suits: Empirical or design-space studies that pick one decision per stage in sequence, such as ablation pipelines, training recipes or system-configuration studies.

evidence: The design of our research. At each stage (from left to right), we examine different modeling decisions
A bold border indicates the decision we made at each stage
Our research design illustrated in Figure 1 has eight stages.

summary: The paper is a systematic study of task-specific knowledge distillation for natural language generation, where a small student imitates a large teacher; it extends sequence-level KD with pseudo-target (PT) augmentation and proposes a Joint-Teaching method. Figure 1 lays out the research design as eight stages read left to right (S1 architecture, S2 pruning, S3 objective, S4 to S8 the use of pseudo-targets), joined by heavy arrows under a banner that states the realistic setup. Each stage is a column of coloured option boxes and a bold border marks the decision taken. A separate olive column at the right covers the extreme setup with no labeled data, GPT-4 teaching T5-S.
summary_zh: 论文系统研究面向 NLG 的任务专用知识蒸馏。图 1 把研究设计画成八个自左向右的阶段（架构、剪枝、目标、伪目标等），每阶段一列彩色选项框，粗边框标出所选方案；右侧另有无标注数据、GPT-4 教 T5-S 的极端设置列。
notes: Prior labels reversed in order: stage-pipeline first, because the heavy arrows chain eight decisions; scope-overview kept for the option menus. I count two titled units (Realistic Setup banner with the eight columns, and the Extreme setup column) although the index says one panel. The wide grey No PTs bar is read as 'later stages do not apply without PTs', which is an inference from its span. The preview shows the top of the caption text at its bottom edge, which is not part of the figure.
